cells.title: Add a claude-session transport to herding run
cells.action: Per D1 and D2: add a claude-session transport to `bee herding run`. New flags `--session-model <model>` and optional `--session-effort <low|medium|high|xhigh|max>`; with `--session-model`, run takes this transport instead of paseo or a pane (refuse `--session-model` together with `--agent` or `--no-pane`). Follow execute_paseo (run.rs:3497) for the shape: write the inbox marker, build the herding brief and child env the same way, set BEE_HERDING_READ_ONLY=1 and apply claude_worker_guard_missing on --read-only. Spawn from inside bee, never through a shell, behind a trait like PaseoCli so tests use a fake: argv `claude --bg --name <name> --model <model> [--effort <e>] --permission-mode bypassPermissions --settings {"worktree":{"bgIsolation":"none"}} <prompt>` with cwd = --cwd. Name = `bee-<cell id or kind>-<short job id>`. Parse the id from the `backgrounded · <id> · <name>` line. Poll `claude agents --json --all` for that id and the mailbox result for round 1 with the same decisions the paseo loop makes (result -> done; status idle twice with no result -> TimedOutIdle; state failed or stopped, or id gone -> died; ceiling -> stop and timed out). Run `claude stop <id>` after the result or a give-up. Write `session_id` and `steer_to` (the session name) into the job record and the run JSON output, and have `bee herding status --job <id>` print `steer_to`. Per D1 for a paseo run whose provider is claude: after spawn, find the one session in `claude agents --json --all` whose cwd equals --cwd and whose startedAt is after the spawn time, and record its name as steer_to; when none or several match, omit steer_to. The claude binary is `claude` unless `herding.claude_command` names another.

truths: a run with --session-model spawns exactly one claude --bg process with bgIsolation none and the given model
the run returns the worker's mailbox result as its JSON output, the same shape a paseo run returns
a session that goes idle twice with no result, fails, or hits the ceiling is stopped and reported, never left running
--read-only sets BEE_HERDING_READ_ONLY=1 in the session env

artifacts.substantive: spawn argv builder, id parser, agents-json parser, poll decisions, unit tests on a fake CLI

key_links: run.rs takes the claude-session transport when --session-model is given
job record and run output carry session_id and steer_to
a paseo claude run records steer_to when exactly one matching claude session is listed
prohibitions: No change to the paseo, herdr or tmux transports' behavior
Never read results from claude logs
open_choices: How the fake CLI trait is shaped, as long as no unit test runs the real claude binary

cells.title: Route native Claude dispatches to sub-sessions
cells.action: Per D2 and D3: in the runtime-claude native arm of dispatch prepare (prepare.rs:2858, the `_ =>` arm that builds the Agent payload), when the slot resolves a configured model, `dispatch.claude_sessions` in the main checkout's config is not false, and `claude` (or herding.claude_command) resolves on PATH, emit tool Bash with the herding command built the same way as the herding arm (prepare.rs:2619: --task-file - --json, --cwd for the worktree, --cell-id for cells, --read-only for gather and advisor, --ceiling from config) plus `--session-model <model>` and `--session-effort <effort>` when an effort is chosen; stdin is the herding pane prompt; channel `claude-session`; transport_ready true with a reason naming the binary. When the CLI is missing, keep the Agent payload and add fallback_reason `claude_cli_missing`. When the switch is false, the payload is byte-identical to today. A session-model escalation keeps the Agent payload. Codex and Pi arms do not change.

truths: on runtime claude a native-model slot for cell, gather, reviewer and advisor returns a Bash bee herding run command carrying --session-model
dispatch.claude_sessions false returns the Agent payload unchanged
no claude CLI on PATH returns the Agent payload with fallback_reason claude_cli_missing
codex and pi payloads are unchanged
key_links: the emitted command uses the --session-model flag cssd-1 added
prohibitions: No change to the herding arm for herding-configured slots

cells.title: Document sub-session dispatch and steering
cells.action: Per D1-D3: in packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md, extend the 'A leader watches a worker' line: a leader may steer a Claude worker (a claude-session job or a Claude herding pane) with SendMessage to the steer_to name bee herding status prints, and still never reads its transcript. Write the knowledge concept claude-session-transport.md (what it is, the claude --bg argv, bgIsolation none, the poll decisions, steer_to, the dispatch.claude_sessions switch and the PATH fallback, the worker-outward guard reason it spawns inside bee, Pointers to claude_session.rs and prepare.rs) and link it from the area index. Add one line to swarming-reference.md on steering. Run .bee/bin/bee dev regen so AGENTS.md matches.

truths: AGENTS.md permits steering a Claude worker with SendMessage and keeps the no-transcript rule

artifacts.substantive: concept with Pointers to claude_session.rs and prepare.rs

key_links: AGENTS.md matches the block after bee dev regen
prohibitions: Do not edit AGENTS.md by hand outside regen
